warn.summary: Turn off TLS 1.0 and 1.1 so only TLS 1.2 and 1.3 are accepted.

generic: Managed hosts and CDNs usually have a 'minimum TLS version' setting. Set it to TLS 1.2.
On your own server, set the protocols to TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only (for nginx: ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;).
Very old browsers and devices will stop working, which is expected.
cpanel: In WHM, under Apache Configuration, then Global Configuration, set SSL Protocols to exclude TLS 1.0 and 1.1. On shared hosting ask your host to do this.

fail.summary: Enable TLS 1.2 or 1.3 on the server.

generic: Update the server software or ask your host to enable TLS 1.2 and 1.3.
Managed hosts and CDNs usually offer this as a setting.
